t_advice_summary_textbox.text: to take note of the colours of the gnomes that give you more mushrooms. certain colours will be better, but it may vary.Use the x1 to experiment and try and figure out the pattern.

vb_textbox.text: Pay attention to the colour of the gnomes hat as this can impact how many mushrooms you gather.some of the 'rules' I found were:yellow over red gnomepink over green gnomepurple over brown gnomeThere is some trial and error to try and find patterns, but percevere. A good time to test is when it is x1, as this won't impact you as much.Make sure you are quick to choose, the time goes quicker than you think.
